items.name: Charcoal
items.description: A bag or pile of lump charcoal, used as fuel for charcoal grills and smokers.
items.notes: Fuel type for the charcoal-fueled appliance family (charcoal grill, charcoal smoker) - being added to the fuel category alongside diesel/gasoline/propane/wood. Icon only, no model needed, matching the rest of the fuel category style.

items.name: High Capacity Water Well Pump
items.description: A large electric well pump for a high-output well, capable of supplying a bigger property's full water demand.
items.notes: Water category producer, higher-tier than the existing water_pump_jet_shallow_well. Icon only.

items.name: Low Capacity Water Well Pump
items.description: A small electric well pump for a low-output well, drawing groundwater into the property's water system.
items.notes: Water category producer, mirrors water_pump but rated lower flow - fills a real gap flagged while building out the water schema (fuel/power/plumbing simulation). Icon only.

items.name: Manual Well
items.description: A traditional stone or wood-framed hand-dug well with a bucket on a rope, drawn up by hand - no power or pump required.
items.notes: Off-grid/manual water producer, the no-power fallback counterpart to the electric well pumps. Icon only.

items.name: Hand Pump Well Head
items.description: A manual lever-action pitcher pump mounted on a well head, drawing water by hand without electricity.
items.notes: Off-grid/manual water producer, mechanical (arm-powered) rather than a bucket-and-rope. Icon only.

items.name: Shower Stall
items.description: A basic bathroom shower stall, connected to the water and electrical/water-heater systems, used for bathing.
items.notes: Fills a real gap flagged while building out the wellness/hygiene mechanic - not showering lowers wellness over time and there is currently no item to restore it. Needs wellness_modifier (positive, on use) and water_usage_lpm once created, same pattern as the sink/washer. Icon only.

items.name: Winter Coat
items.description: A heavy insulated winter coat, worn outdoors in cold weather to prevent wellness loss from cold exposure.
items.notes: Fills a real gap flagged while building out the wellness/weather mechanic - there is currently NO clothing/apparel category or item in the catalog at all. Going outside in winter without it should reduce wellness; wearing it should prevent/offset that penalty. This is likely the first item of a future clothing category rather than a true appliance - flagging that category question for whoever picks this up. Icon only.

items.name: Fiberglass Insulation Batt
items.description: A roll/batt of fiberglass wall insulation, installed inside stud cavities before drywall goes up.
items.notes: Real construction-recipe gap flagged while building out structures.construction_recipe - no house insulation exists in the catalog at all (only fence t-post insulators, unrelated). Icon only.

items.name: Interior Wall Paint
items.description: A bucket of interior wall paint, applied over finished drywall as the final construction step.
items.notes: Real construction-recipe gap - no paint/finish item exists in the catalog. Icon only.

items.name: Chinking
items.description: Add a loop of chinking used in the process of building a log cabin
